answer: A farm of 35 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in violet, queued in forge, and pulse publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 67 identities per epoch. A farm of 892 identities would post 4107 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
